svg.title: From a button to durable business records.
svg.desc: MainFrame • LoginPanel • Operational panels: Screens capture input, selection and draft state. UiTask / SwingWorker move database work off the EDT. Busy and leave guards coordinate navigation and writes.; Product • OrderLine • Session • Validator: Models carry named records and saved amounts. BigDecimal computes currency; rules check business input. Session notifications update the signed-in identity.; OrderDao • LedgerDao • UserDao • other DAOs: Prepared statements bind values separately from SQL. Transactions own row locks, validation and commit. Database resolves settings and opens JDBC connections.; Eight InnoDB tables • PrintDocument: MySQL stores related sales, balances and catalog data. PrintDocument shares snapshot layout with preview/print. There is no HTTP server; each desktop uses JDBC.
svg.text: AQUATRACK3-GPT-CLAUDE_1 / FIELD GUIDE
From a button to durable business records.
Source-based instructions • Open the SVG to zoom • Read the full README
01 WORKSPACE / UI
MainFrame • LoginPanel • Operational panels
Screens capture input, selection and draft state.
UiTask / SwingWorker move database work off the EDT.
Busy and leave guards coordinate navigation and writes.
02 MODELS / SHARED RULES
Product • OrderLine • Session • Validator
Models carry named records and saved amounts.
BigDecimal computes currency; rules check business input.
Session notifications update the signed-in identity.
03 DATA ACCESS
OrderDao • LedgerDao • UserDao • other DAOs
Prepared statements bind values separately from SQL.
Transactions own row locks, validation and commit.
Database resolves settings and opens JDBC connections.
04 PERSISTENCE / PRINT
Eight InnoDB tables • PrintDocument
MySQL stores related sales, balances and catalog data.
PrintDocument shares snapshot layout with preview/print.
There is no HTTP server; each desktop uses JDBC.
Java Swing • JDBC • MySQL | Source: uploaded Aquatrack3-gpt-claude_1
